narrative.title: The Solar Panel String Survey
narrative.scenario: A rooftop survey maps a grid of mounting points as either reinforced (1) or not (0). The installation crew wants to deploy one big square solar string whose anchors occupy a perfect block of reinforced points only. Survey software must report the area of the largest such square block anywhere on the roof.
narrative.inputFormat: An m x n binary matrix matrix of '0' and '1' characters.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the area of the largest square submatrix consisting entirely of 1s.

testCases.explanation: A 2x2 block of 1s sits in the middle-right region; area 4.
No 2x2 block exists, but single reinforced points give area 1.

hintLevels: Level 1: A big square needs its top-left, top, and left neighbors to each support a slightly smaller square.
Level 2: side[i][j] = 1 + min of the three neighbors when matrix[i][j] == 1, else 0.
Level 3: Track the maximum side during the fill and square it at the end; a padded border row/col removes edge cases.
